components.explanation: lamp_post, oil_drop and pit_prop: built in Blender through the MCP (tools/blender/build_*.py), all transforms applied, exported as glTF binary with +Y Up (tools/blender/export_glb.py); Godot imports them with root scale 1.0.

asset_room.tscn: a 4 x 2 m floor at y 0, one DirectionalLight3D plus ambient, the three instanced assets at height 0 and a Wick-sized stand-in box; orbit_camera.gd lets a viewer (or the capture driver) look from behind and below; capture_a3_room.gd saves scripted evidence screenshots.

check_a3_assets.gd loads each imported .glb and the room and checks size, bounds, base at y 0, upright axis, node scale and rotation, triangles, albedo, and each asset against the Floor node's top (30 checks).

[node name="LampPost" parent="." instance=ExtResource("1_lamp")]
position = Vector3(-1.4, 0, 0)

[node name="WickStandIn" type="MeshInstance3D" parent="."]
position = Vector3(-0.8, 0.175, 0)
mesh = SubResource("BoxMesh_wick")
surface_material_override/0 = SubResource("Material_wick")

[node name="PitProp" parent="." instance=ExtResource("3_pit")]
position = Vector3(0.3, 0, 0)

[node name="OilDrop" parent="." instance=ExtResource("2_oil")]
position = Vector3(1.5, 0, 0)

var b := merged_aabb(node, null)
				var over_floor := b.position.x >= floor_box.position.x and b.end.x <= floor_box.end.x \
					and b.position.z >= floor_box.position.z and b.end.z <= floor_box.end.z
				# measured against the Floor node's own top, not against the asset itself
				check(asset + ".rests_on_floor", absf(b.position.y - floor_y) <= TOL and over_floor,
